name: fresh-am-keyword-substring-router
route_is: candidate routing, never causal proof, never a seven-gate verdict
recall_limitations: Does not inspect git history, commit trailers, Co-authored-by, or bot authors.
Does not read advisory details, descriptions, references, or commit subjects.
English substring list only; non-English advisories and unmarked AI brands are missed.
Short tokens produce false positives (agent in user-agent or atomic-agents-stack; gpt as a path fragment).
False negatives: AI-authored introductions in conventional libraries whose repo name and summary omit the keyword list.
A ROUTE hit is not origin evidence. A NOT_ROUTE hit is not negative proof of non-AI origin.
Deep-reviewed sample is not drawn exclusively from ROUTE; some August/commit-ref clones were selected outside this router. That second path is not mechanically complete.
